scope: 500 complete literary works selected as new or unfinished Vietnamese translation tasks. This is an editorial production queue, not an objective universal ranking, a verified 500-work translation gap, or publication clearance. Previously published Wilde The Artist and Machado Um Apólogo are excluded.
methodology: Selection combines literary significance, distinctive form and voice, geographic and linguistic breadth, women authors and the potential usefulness of a lawful, complete, source-aligned open Vietnamese edition. Rationales are editorial judgments, not measured demand.

300 selections cover Europe, the Americas and Oceania; 200 cover Asia, Africa and the Middle East, including diaspora traditions. At most six works per named author are selected, with anonymous traditions treated separately. Whole collections are not counted again through selected constituent stories.

The first three execution tasks finish the existing Pardo draft and add complete Chopin and Saki stories. The first 20 give a bounded cross-language runway; remaining candidates are interleaved 3:2 across curation groups, within readiness state and initial priority band. Order is revisable production judgment, not a comparative claim about intrinsic literary greatness.

Titles may be original-language or established international discovery labels. Source records explicitly distinguish item-level records, anthology coverage, author bibliographies and broader leads. Catalog metadata or search evidence does not attest to an exact original-language source or its complete text.
Only corroborated first-publication years are populated. Gutenberg digital release dates and merged catalog dates are not silently substituted; other dates remain null.

Vietnamese supply is not audited for most entries. Existing dated Atlas findings are linked for matching works, without upgrading bounded absence searches or treating existing versions as inadequate. No demand study or first-translation claim is made.

Likely-public-domain is only a screening hypothesis. Permission-dependent works are blocked_rights; unresolved witness or territorial questions are blocked_source. Each production source and translated edition requires its own recorded lawful basis before publication.

A published task must correspond to a complete public Vietnamese corpus edition. The unchanged v2 gate requires one full AI assessment, exact current title/content evidence and an unrounded weighted score of at least 8.6, plus the existing source/rights/serious-finding checks. Human feedback is optional after release.
